notes.title: First Major Update for Funny Cargo Simulator Demo
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559760/05d81b1892e83d015863fdfe6bd898d1446cff85.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Gameplay Features Added[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Police[/b]:
The police help deal with drunks wandering around. However, if you hit customers, they'll catch you and issue a fine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drunks[/b]:
Randomly wandering drunks will bother customers. You can hit them, and the police will be tolerant of this.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Punching[/b]:
The punching ability was previously only effective against thieves. Now, you can use it on customers, drunks, and police. Hitting customers who leave bad reviews can relieve your frustration, but it will lower your popularity score. Hitting customers near the police will cause them to attack you and impose a fine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customer Reactions[/b]:
With the ability to hit customers, new animations and sound effects have been added, making NPCs more realistic and the game more engaging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Car[/b]:
Considering the map’s size, players will receive a free car at the start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cash Register[/b]:
To reduce idle time, a cash register section has been added. Customers will come to a dedicated cashier for transactions. You set the price, but setting it too high may cause the customer to cancel the order. There's a small chance to sell slightly above the item’s value.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Delivery Fees[/b]:
Delivery fees have been increased, allowing for faster progression in the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Update[/b]:
The car purchase shop has been removed from the map. Instead, car purchases will now be made through a tablet. This feature is currently inactive but will soon allow buying new vehicles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thieves[/b]:
Thieves will appear more frequently, emphasizing the need for security. Security is the most effective way to stop them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial[/b]:
A tutorial screen has been added for new players, explaining the UI elements. The screen disappears after 30 seconds or by pressing “Enter.”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shortcut Keys[/b]:
The shortcut keys on the left have been updated and made more visible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Languages[/b]:
Translation issues in some languages have been fixed.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Funny Cargo Simulator Demo Update
notes.content:
[url=https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45592627/bc795095d02835d9c4ee6c49d0a39ae51182fe83.png][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45592627/84857f68ed0b692044f2b6c073e87b363e36ee72.png[/img][/url]

[b]Funny Cargo Simulator Demo Update
[/b]
This major update introduces the following new features and bug fixes to the game.

                            
[u][b]NEW ADDITIONS:[/b][/u]

[b]Thief Character[/b]: A thief character has been added. Until you purchase security, a thief may visit your shop at certain intervals and steal your cargo. To prevent this, you can now knock out the thief with a punch.

[b]Trash System[/b]: Clean up the trash generated by customers to increase your shop’s popularity. However, failing to clean the trash will decrease your popularity score.

[b]Surprise Box[/b]: You can find a surprise box in a random location on the map. This box may contain money or an energy drink, allowing you to move twice as fast for quicker deliveries and higher earnings. More surprises will be added to the box in the future.

[b]Cashier Count[/b]: Due to the insufficiency of cashiers over time, the number of cashiers has been increased from 3 to 6. You can make purchases via the tablet.

[b]Courier Textures:[/b] Courier textures have been added, making them more visually appealing and distinct.
                       
 [u][b]FIXED BUGS[/b][/u]:

[b]Courier Pathfinding[/b]: The courier pathfinding system has been updated and fixed. Couriers can now deliver to different locations, and slowdowns at certain corners have been resolved.

[b]Customer Queue[/b]: Issues with long customer queues and related delivery errors have been fixed. Customers no longer form excessively long queues.

[b]Cashier and Courier Upgrades[/b]: Upgrade costs were sometimes too cheap or too expensive, disrupting game balance. Upgrade costs have now been adjusted to align with the game’s flow.




[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45592627/bc795095d02835d9c4ee6c49d0a39ae51182fe83.png[/img]
